views.text: In July 2026, Equity Mates described IDEXX Laboratories' vet lab equipment and diagnostic tests as widely used in clinics, with machines installed once and consumables required for each test.

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In July 2026, Equity Mates said IDEXX Laboratories followed a classic printer and ink model, where installed analysers drove ongoing consumables demand as vets ran more tests, supporting recurring revenue.
